name: Zipwing · Gremlet #19
description:
A dragonfly with huge shiny eyes. Zips everywhere, stops for nothing.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Zipwing in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
